problem:
For the matrix
$B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -3 \\ 4 & 0 & 5 \\ 7 & -2 & 6\end{aligned}].$
find the minor ${M}_{22}$ of the entry ${b}_{22}.$

${M}_{22}=${{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The minor of ${b}_{22}=0$ (second row, second column) is the determinant of the remaining entries when the column and row containing $0$ are removed: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & -3 \\ ∗ & 0 & ∗ \\ 7 & ∗ & 6\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor of ${b}_{22}=0$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{M}_{22} & =\text{det}[\begin{aligned}1 & -3 \\ 7 & 6\end{aligned}] \\  & =|\begin{aligned}1 & -3 \\ 7 & 6\end{aligned}| \\  & =1\cdot 6-(-3)\cdot 7 \\  & =6-(-21) \\  & =6+21 \\  & =27.\end{aligned}
$$
